name: School of ICT Access Scholarship
summary: Up to $5,000 for students facing educational disadvantage starting an IT degree at Griffith.
key: Maximum value of $5,000, paid in two instalments.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Applying to commence university for the first time in Trimester 1 2027.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 11 January 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
The ICT degree must be your first preference on QTAC or UAC.
